messages:
Priya (Marketing): Heads up — aiming to publish the release announcement tomorrow 10:00 PDT. Need a quick sync: changelog URL, docs final link, bench narrative, webinar CTA, and inbound lead routing. Can engineering confirm canary window and any rollback note? @Ethan @Omar

Ethan (Engineering): Can confirm canary 09:00-09:30 PDT (30m). We'll run staged rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% in ~15m steps. No config changes expected. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/392 — pending one dev review.

Lina (Docs): Docs final URL will be https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-optimizer once the PR merges. I updated the quickstart and the "cost controls" section, and swapped the hero screenshot caption. Can marketing double-check the screenshot alt text?

Omar (SRE): deploy-bot scheduled canary at 09:00. Added monitors for p95/p99 latency and error rate. Auto-fail conditions: error_rate > 0.5% for 5m or p99 increase > 2x. Runbook snippet I posted in #incidents: ```If canary fails -> revert to previous artifact -> scale down canary -> open incident and notify oncall@redwood.ai```

Ben (Product): For the benchmark narrative, let's lead with: "2x unit-cost reduction using adaptive batching at typical prompt lengths" and call out the latency win on 4k-token slices. I'll drop the short blurb (two sentences + a single stat callout) into #marketing-drafts by EOD.

Priya (Marketing): Inbound routing — can we funnel webinar signups and demo requests to SFDC queue `Launch_Inbound` with source tag `announce_webinar_2023`? Who owns the mapping? @Lina can you include the hidden field on the registration form?

Lina (Docs): Yep — final registration page includes hidden field source=announce_webinar_2023 and UTM parameters. I'll push the tracking update alongside the docs merge.

Ethan (Engineering): Changelog PR just got approved, merging in ~10m. I'll post the final URL when done. ETA ~08:30 PDT.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2023-06-26T09:00:00Z. Rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Health checks: latency_p95 < 250ms, errors < 0.5%. Notifying #release-notifications on each step.

Priya (Marketing): Perfect — thanks everyone. @Ben once the blurb is up we'll finalize social copy + webinar invite + the hero image. Quick ask: please confirm we have a single canonical docs URL (the one Lina posted) before publishing. :rocket:
